digest.component_or_area: binding store recovery and retirement completion
propositions: Crashed retirement leaves exact same identity both live and retired; recovery must complete this detectable partial state safely at the pre-observation write boundary without mutating read-only operations

Retirement completion requires exact local id and Jira key agreement across tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry; any mismatch or corrupt file causes typed safety abort without unrelated mutation
Tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; later automatic confirms (200/clear_absent/same-key) do not override it; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion

Completion is invoked once in reconcile.py after under-lock staleness validation but before first remote issue fetch; all other modes (construction, load, preview, dry-run, selection, filter) perform zero writes
Rich-text handler must stop mutating entries obtained from all_bindings() and use the narrow facade operation instead
Create recovery moves to binding_recovery.py unchanged; keyless pending requires both three misses and 3600 seconds before unbind; per-entry failures remain loud and nonfatal
